configurePresets.name: windows-msvc-32bit
configurePresets.description: 32-bit MSVC build with /arch:IA32 for compiler-generated x87 arithmetic.

configurePresets.name: windows-msvc-64bit
configurePresets.description: 64-bit MSVC build. Compiler-generated arithmetic uses SSE2 or newer instructions and may differ from the original x87 arithmetic.

configurePresets.name: windows-clangcl-64bit
configurePresets.description: Preferred x64 compiler for existing WIDE_FLOAT/long double x87 paths; ordinary float/double arithmetic remains SSE. Requires Clang 22+.

configurePresets.name: linux-gcc-64bit
configurePresets.description: Native GCC build of the dedicated server and its game module. Requires GCC on x86 or x86-64; the faithful build uses native x87 arithmetic. The Makefile targets remain available for 32-bit builds.

configurePresets.name: linux-clang-64bit
configurePresets.description: Native Clang build of the dedicated server and its game module. Clang cannot generate the faithful x87 model architecture, so this preset selects the acknowledged relaxed floating-point policy. Use the GCC preset when float-faithful output matters.
